text: {"scratchpad": "I've reviewed the code. The bug is clear: charge_amount() uses simple int() truncation instead of banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). The test expects 105 * 1.5 = 157.5 to round to 158 (banker's rounding rounds .5 to nearest even). I need to: 1) Ask dev to fix the code using Decimal with ROUND_HALF_EVEN, 2) Run tests to verify the fix, 3) Approve the release, 4) Have ops deploy.
